entities.name: Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The end of the unnatural centuries-long day and night cycles of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and the collapse of Oona's dominion.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane with alternating Lorwyn and Shadowmoor halves.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Fae queen who long manipulated the plane's time.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Created from Oona's memories, she rivals and kills Oona.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Elemental who ascended as the Extinguisher and lost her sanity.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Safewright of the Wilt-Leaf who absorbs the sapling's poison.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: Untouched by the Aurora due to the Crescent of Morningtide.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: Owner of a prophetic scroll that aids Maralen.

entities.name: Crescent of Morningtide
entities.description: Artifact that protected Brigid and aided Maralen.

entities.name: Sapling of Colfenor
entities.description: Sapling killed by Oona; its poison is absorbed by Rhys.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event a year before the fusion.

entities.name: Pendulum Year
entities.description: Period of wild adjustment after the fusion.

events.summary: Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent and challenges Oona.
events.quote: Maralen succeeded in temporarily stealing Ashling’s power for herself.

events.summary: Oona kills the Sapling of Colfenor, and Rhys absorbs its poison.
events.quote: Oona killed the Sapling of Colfenor in a final act of spite

events.summary: Ashling regains her power and sanity and joins Rhys against Oona.
events.quote: Restored to herself, Ashling joined Rhys in a final assault against Oona.

events.summary: Maralen deals Oona the killing blow with moonglove.
events.quote: Maralen dealt the killing blow using moonglove

events.summary: Oona's death collapses the artificial cycles, and the plane enters the Pendulum Year before Eirdu and Isilu restore balance.
events.quote: the plane entered what would be recorded as the Pendulum Year .

events.summary: The Vendilion clique, the elven monarchs and countless fae and elves perish; Ashling is freed of her madness and Maralen becomes queen of the fae.
events.quote: Maralen stood triumphant as the world's new queen of the fae.

events.summary: Oona is reborn in secret in Glen Elendra.
events.quote: she was shown to be reborn, her essence reconstituted in secret.

relations.quote: Maralen dealt the killing blow using moonglove

relations.note: Maralen was born from Oona's memories and became her rival

relations.quote: Restored to herself, Ashling joined Rhys in a final assault against Oona.
